sloka: तत् अन्नम् मैथिली प्राप्य विज्ञाय इन्द्रात् इदम् तु इति ।अग्रम् उद्धृत्य रामाय भू तले निर्वपिष्यति ॥४-६२-९॥
transliteration: tat annam maithilī prāpya vijñāya indrāt idam tu iti ।agram uddhṛtya rāmāya bhū tale nirvapiṣyati ॥4-62-9॥

translations.english: 'Having understood that it has been provided by Indra, Sita will take out a large portion of it and pour it on the ground (as an offering to Rama) and say 'I offer it to Rama wherever he is on earth'.
